question:
A shopkeeper offers the following three schemes:

I. Buy 9 get 1 free

II. Buy 7 get 8

III. Two successive discounts of 20% and 15%

Which scheme has the lowest discount percentage (all articles have the same marked price)?
solution:
**Given:**

Scheme I: Buy 9 get 1 free

Scheme II: Buy 7 get 8

Scheme III: Two successive discounts of 20% and 15%

**Formula Used:**

Discount Percentage = (Savings / Total Cost) × 100

**Calculation:**

**Scheme I:**

For every 10 items, 1 item is free.

Effective cost for 10 items = 9 items' cost

Discount Percentage = (1 / 10) × 100

⇒ Discount Percentage = 10%
